_about: Honors S652 follow-ups dry run: two title updates and two dismissal inserts (cohort honors-s652@bot). Written by kb/_honors_followups_s652.py --plan; nothing applied.
no_title_row_for_the_honors_records: The export builds a stand-alone row's title from its catalog record and the worklist replays a curated title only on a merge target, so a unified_title row on HUMA M10ME or LIBR M10CJ would be inert; the CCN form waits for an export change or card 3's Honors build.
select_before: select jsonb_build_object('title_rows', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(k) order by k.course_id), '[]'::jsonb) from public.kb_curation k where k.field = 'unified_title' and k.course_id in ('HUMA M1110', 'LIBR M1040')), 'rows_on_honors_records', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(k) order by k.course_id, k.field), '[]'::jsonb) from public.kb_curation k where k.course_id in ('HUMA M10ME', 'LIBR M10CJ')), 'insert_slots_taken', (select count(*) from public.kb_curation k where (k.course_id, k.field) in (('HUMA M10ME', 'merge_dismissed'), ('LIBR M1040', 'merge_dismissed'))), 'dismissals_naming_the_ids', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('course_id', k.course_id, 'value', k.value, 'reviewer', case when k.reviewer_email like '%@bot' then k.reviewer_email else 'a person' end)), '[]'::jsonb) from public.kb_curation k where k.field = 'merge_dismissed' and (k.value like '%HUMA M10ME%' or k.value like '%LIBR M10CJ%' or k.value like '%HUMA M1110%' or k.value like '%LIBR M1040%')), 'person_rows', (select count(*) from public.kb_curation p where p.reviewer_email not like '%@bot' and (p.course_id in ('HUMA M10ME', 'LIBR M10CJ', 'HUMA M1110', 'LIBR M1040') or (p.field in ('merge_into', 'unified_title_merge_confirm', 'merge_dismissed') and (p.value like '%HUMA M10ME%' or p.value like '%LIBR M10CJ%' or p.value like '%HUMA M1110%' or p.value like '%LIBR M1040%')))));
